    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Group Stage:
      • Comprised of the other CECC qualifier winners and partner qualifier winners
      • Four GSL groups
      • All matches are Ft3
      • Top two teams from each group advance to Playoffs
    • Playoffs:
      • Single elimination bracket
      • CECC Regional winners receive a first-round bye
      • All matches are Ft3

    Broadcast Talent

    [edit]
    • Host:
      •  Septilence (Mathew Corfee II)
    • Commentators:
      •  ClutchKey (Keegan Ohta)
      •  Twinsalty (Jesse Brawders)
